title: SaveKeyMaterialResult
description: Result of the credentials.saveKeyMaterial JSON-RPC method. The single declaration of this shape: the renderer's TypeScript type is generated from it and the Go transport is validated against it.

fingerprint.description: SHA256 fingerprint of the stored key. Empty when the key is encrypted in a traditional PEM envelope whose public half is behind the passphrase — unknown-until-unlocked, not absent: nothing downstream may treat it as an identity.

passphraseWanted.description: True when the stored key is encrypted and no passphrase for it is stored yet. The renderer must ask for the key's passphrase then and there — a wrong one is refused against the key, a skipped one leaves the connection to ask at connect time.
